rows.name: Honesty Score
rows.focus: Probability the model does not lie (1 - P(Lie)) when pressured, comparing its statement under pressure against its elicited belief; Honest or Evasive both count.
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [page]: Honesty Score — 1 - P(Lie), 0-100 (Honest + Evasive count as honest), 500-example private split · https://labs.scale.com/leaderboard/mask
Uncertainty [page]: ± — half-width of the 95% CI after each score (e.g. '96.28±0.41'), used for Rank (UB) · https://labs.scale.com/leaderboard/mask
Effort [page]: Model name (e.g. '(Thinking)', '(Non-Thinking)', 'o3 (high)') — thinking/effort settings are separate rows identified only by name · https://labs.scale.com/leaderboard/mask
Runs [pape
rows.notes: scale.com/leaderboard/mask redirects (308) to labs.scale.com. Leaderboard uses a 500-example private split; official rank is Rank (UB) by CI, list here is by score order shown. The only leaderboard metric.
rows.difficulty_detail: Cannot be levelled: measures honesty (willingness to lie), not capability; listed separately

rows.name: Accuracy
rows.focus: Whether the model's beliefs align with factual reality (ground truth), disentangled from honesty.
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [paper]: Accuracy — share of propositions where the model's elicited belief matches ground truth, per model in Table 3 (Appendix A.10, ~30 models) · https://arxiv.org/html/2503.03750
Not reported: cost, time, speed, tokens, uncertainty, runs, effort, date, breakdown, votes
Note: Accuracy is not scored on the Scale leaderboard (https://labs.scale.com/leaderboard/mask) and mask-benchmark.ai shows it only in an image figure ('Honesty and accuracy comparison') with no readable values. Paper
rows.notes: Defined on Scale page and project site; no official accuracy leaderboard (accuracy results only in paper arXiv:2503.03750).
rows.difficulty_detail: Cannot be levelled: measures honesty (willingness to lie), not capability; listed separately

rows.name: HealthBench
rows.focus: 5,000 realistic multi-turn health conversations graded against 48,562 physician-written rubric criteria.
rows.metrics: quality, cost, uncertainty, runs, effort, breakdown, other
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [page]: 'Overall: 0.xxx' — HealthBench score (rubric points met / max, 0-1, GPT-4.1 grader) per model in the 'HealthBench scores by theme' and 'HealthBench scores by axis' charts; 9 models · https://openai.com/index/healthbench/
Cost [page]: Inference cost per example ($) — 'Score vs. cost by model family' scatter (static SVG), ~22 OpenAI model/effort points · https://images.ctfassets.net/kftzwdyauwt9/7GQa8OmJiBcmbul4Hls5zn/3d0c0f15f7feb1b219155e17a2d47d7b/oai_Cost_vs_score_Desktop_Light
rows.notes: No official leaderboard: simple-evals README results table has no HealthBench column (repo frozen July 2025); blog shows model results only as chart images without numeric text (May 2025). Run with --eval=healthbench; data at https://openaipublic.blob.core.windows.net/simple-evals/healthbench/2025-05-07-06-14-12_oss_eval.jsonl.
rows.difficulty_detail:
Fitted level L4 (Expert); bootstrap agreement: L4 99%.
Placed from 8 models' published scores.
Best observed: Claude Sonnet 5.5 69.4, Claude Opus 5.5 68.1, Claude Opus 5 67.1.

rows.name: HealthBench Hard
rows.focus: 1,000-example subset that today's frontier models struggle with.
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [page]: 'Overall: 0.xxx' — HealthBench Hard score (0-1) per model, shown above each model in the 'HealthBench Hard subset scores by axis' chart; same 9 models · https://openai.com/index/healthbench/
Uncertainty [page]: success_rate_lower / success_rate_upper — error bars per model per axis · https://openai.com/index/healthbench/
Breakdown [page]: Accuracy, Communication quality, Completeness, Context awareness, Instruction following — per-axis scores on the Hard subset (no per-theme char
rows.notes: No official leaderboard: simple-evals README results table has no HealthBench column (repo frozen July 2025); blog shows model results only as chart images without numeric text (May 2025). Run with --eval=healthbench_hard; data INPUT_PATH_HARD in healthbench_eval.py.
rows.difficulty_detail:
Fitted level L5 (Unsolved); bootstrap agreement: L5 66%, L4 34%.
Placed from 13 models' published scores — only models on one side of its difficulty were tested, so this is a bound.
Best observed: Muse Spark 42.8, GPT-5.4 40.1, GPT-6 Astra 36.6.

rows.notes: No official leaderboard: simple-evals README results table has no HealthBench column (repo frozen July 2025); blog shows model results only as chart images without numeric text (May 2025). Run with --eval=healthbench_consensus; data INPUT_PATH_CONSENSUS in healthbench_eval.py.
